about/index.html.text: Skip to content A fictional studio. A real test of better website visibility. Fieldnote Studio Work About Better questions. Clearer work. Fieldnote Studio is a small fictional world built for a practical purpose: testing how Sparser discovers, explains, and helps repair website issues. Listen. Frame. Make. We begin with what a visitor needs to understand. Then we organize the content, choose the few elements that matter, and make the path forward easier to follow. The words, links, and image on this site are deliberate test content. A good repair should improve the underlying page without discarding its character. See the concept projects ↗ The three connected stages of the Fieldnote approach. Made for testing, not for taking briefs. This is a public demonstration fixture.
